scope_rule: Scope rule: every direct-ascent (DA-ASAT) test row that SWF 2026 lists in Table 1-4 (US), Tables 2-4 and 16-2 (Russia), Tables 3-3 and 16-3 (China) and Tables 4-1 and 16-4 (India) is a row in this ledger, including failures, rocket-only tests and tests against a star or no target. Exclusions, all disclosed: co-orbital tests (Table 1-4 also lists the US Delta 180 co-orbital intercept of 5 Sep 1986, which SWF's text calls a co-orbital experiment; Table 16-2's Soviet IS, Naryad, Polyot and Cosmos 2521/2536 entries), and the Table 16-3 line 'Apr. 15, 2023' (treated as a date variant of the 14 Apr 2023 test, see that row's conflicts). Starfish Prime (not an SWF DA-ASAT table row) is the one added nuclear marker.
co_scope_rule: Co-orbital rule: every line of SWF 2026 Table 1-3 (US RPOs), Table 2-3 (Russian RPOs) and Table 3-2 (Chinese RPOs), and every flight in Table 1-1 (X-37B) and Table 3-1 (Chinese reusable experimental spacecraft), is a row with domain co_orbital, dated from the table (or from SWF's text where the row says so and gives the reason). Two exceptions, both disclosed: (a) the Jan. 2022 USA 270 / Shiyan-12 approach is listed in both Table 1-3 and Table 3-2 and is one row; (b) where SWF's text dates separate steps that a table folds into one line (SJ-21 with Compass G2; SJ-21 with SJ-25; the Cosmos 2542 release of Cosmos 2543; the SY-7 release of Payload A Debris; the GSSAP 'flanking' of SJ-21 and SJ-25), the text-dated step is its own row and the row says so. RPO rows record that a proximity operation happened as SWF reports it; they are not attacks, and SWF's wording on intent is hedged and kept in the row.
description: Data files for the Counterspace Timeline. events.json and legal.json are top-level arrays (unchanged shape); capabilities.json is an object. Version bumps: patch = new rows or corrected values; minor = new optional fields; major = shape change.

events.json.shape: array of event rows, sorted by date/start; domain is 'kinetic', 'non_kinetic' or 'co_orbital'

common_fields.source_full: full citation string for a sources list
common_fields.pin: table/passage plus printed page and PDF page
common_fields.conflicts: optional list of disagreements inside the sources

kinetic_fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD (first of the month when date_precision is month)
kinetic_fields.date_precision: optional: day (default) | month, where SWF gives only a month
kinetic_fields.type: destructive | non_destructive | midcourse_intercept | apogee_only | flyby | nuclear

non_kinetic_fields.category: directed_energy | ew_uplink | ew_downlink | gnss_jamming | gnss_spoofing | cyber

co_orbital_fields.start: YYYY-MM-DD (first of the month or 1 Jan. when date_precision is month or year)
co_orbital_fields.end: YYYY-MM-DD, last day of the month or 31 Dec. under month or year precision, or null (ongoing in SWF's Apr. 2026 edition)
co_orbital_fields.date_precision: optional: day (default) | month | year; applies to start and end
co_orbital_fields.system: the acting spacecraft (chaser, releasing vehicle or spaceplane)
co_orbital_fields.target: the approached or released object, or null for a spaceplane mission
co_orbital_fields.orbit_regime: LEO | GEO (belt or its immediate vicinity, incl. the disposal region) | HEO | not_stated
co_orbital_fields.description: the builder's own summary, keeping SWF's hedges
co_orbital_fields.evidence: short verbatim SWF quotation, 1-15 words, supporting the row's central fact

events.json.validation: tools/build_data.py validate() enforces this schema on every build: unique ids, enums, date formats, required fields per domain, required source fields, id resolution, fragments_in_orbit <= fragments_cataloged, capabilities.json states/decades/D-P values, lag_pairs.json ids, and the counts and as-of dates in methodology.md, ledger.md and verification_log.md.

legal.json.shape: array of legal items, sorted by start

fields.pairs: list of {event, law, months, text}: each law lists the event in related_events and is dated later
fields.open: events shown as an open ring (no later related legal item), with basis
fields.dropped: pairs once drawn that have no related_events link; the page must not draw them
